summary: The Cerebras normalizer now rejects explicit null content when no tool call or refusal is present, and a focused test verifies the documented 502 failure for budget-stopped reasoning-only output.

evidence: src/provider/cerebras.ts treats content === null like omitted content for no-payload rejection.
tests/openai-compat-part11.test.ts covers content: null with finish_reason: "length" and asserts the cerebras_upstream_invalid_response 502.
